metadata.business_impact: High - Core functionality broken, professional credibility at risk

critical_issues.title: Missing user_reviews Database Table
critical_issues.description: Write Review button fails because user_reviews table doesn't exist in database
critical_issues.root_cause: Migration files exist but base schema doesn't create user_reviews table
critical_issues.solution: Apply database migrations to create missing table
implementation_steps: Verify table exists with: SELECT * FROM user_reviews LIMIT 1
validation_steps: Check database: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'user_reviews'
Test Write Review button opens dialog without errors
Submit a review and verify it saves to database
Verify review appears in All Reviews tab
critical_issues.business_impact: Blocks review functionality, prevents community building

critical_issues.title: Advanced Options 404 Error
critical_issues.description: Advanced Options button navigates to non-existent /create/advanced route
critical_issues.root_cause: Code navigates to /create/advanced but only /create/study and /create/competition exist
critical_issues.solution: Redirect to existing study page or create advanced page
validation_steps: Click Advanced Options button
Verify navigation works without 404 error
Ensure study/competition features are accessible
Test on both desktop and mobile
critical_issues.business_impact: Blocks access to advanced professional features

critical_issues.title: API-Database Schema Mismatch
critical_issues.description: API creates fields (mode, review_type, product_type) that don't exist in database schema
critical_issues.root_cause: API payload includes fields not defined in database schema
critical_issues.solution: Update API to match database schema or update schema to include missing fields
implementation_steps: Ensure only these fields are used: id, name, description, type, status, created_by, date, characteristics, max_participants, current_participants, is_public, location, meeting_link, tasting_data, created_at, updated_at
Test tasting creation and verify data saves correctly
validation_steps: Create a quick tasting
Verify data saves to database without errors
Check database: SELECT * FROM tastings ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
Verify all expected fields are populated
Test Complete Tasting workflow end-to-end
critical_issues.business_impact: Prevents tastings from being saved, breaks core functionality

critical_issues.title: Complete Tasting Authentication Issues
critical_issues.description: Complete Tasting button may fail due to authentication complexity
critical_issues.root_cause: Complex auth logic with test users and real Supabase sessions
critical_issues.solution: Simplify authentication flow and add better error handling
implementation_steps: Add better error messages for auth failures
Add loading states and error feedback in UI
validation_steps: Test with different user states (authenticated, guest, test user)
Verify error messages appear when auth fails
Test Complete Tasting with network disconnected
Ensure proper user feedback in all scenarios
critical_issues.business_impact: Users can't complete tastings, leading to frustration and abandonment

trust_credibility_issues.title: Mixed Language Interface (English/Spanish)
trust_credibility_issues.description: UI inconsistently mixes English and Spanish text, appearing unprofessional
trust_credibility_issues.solution: Implement proper i18n system and standardize on English for professional audience
implementation_steps: Audit all text strings for language consistency
Remove Spanish text from English interface
Add language selector for future multi-language support
Update all components to use translation keys
validation_steps: Audit all pages for mixed language text
Test interface in single language
Verify no Spanish text appears in English mode
Check professional appearance
trust_credibility_issues.business_impact: Erodes professional credibility, confuses international users
files_to_modify: All .tsx files with mixed language text

trust_credibility_issues.title: Data Inconsistency Across Views
trust_credibility_issues.description: Dashboard, Profile, and History show different tasting counts and data
trust_credibility_issues.root_cause: Data not synchronized between different views and database queries
trust_credibility_issues.solution: Implement centralized data fetching and caching system
implementation_steps: Implement React Query or SWR for data synchronization
Update all components to use shared data sources
Add real-time data updates where appropriate
Ensure consistent data across Dashboard, Profile, History
validation_steps: Create a tasting and verify count updates in all views
Check data consistency between Dashboard and Profile
Verify History shows same data as other views
Test real-time updates
trust_credibility_issues.business_impact: Destroys user trust, makes platform appear unreliable

trust_credibility_issues.title: Silent Error Handling
trust_credibility_issues.description: Application fails silently without user feedback when operations fail
trust_credibility_issues.root_cause: Poor error handling and lack of user feedback mechanisms
trust_credibility_issues.solution: Implement comprehensive error handling with user-friendly messages
implementation_steps: Add try-catch blocks to all async operations
Add loading states for all operations
Add retry mechanisms for failed operations
validation_steps: Trigger various error scenarios
Verify user sees appropriate error messages
Check loading states appear during operations
Test retry functionality
Ensure no silent failures
trust_credibility_issues.business_impact: Frustrates users, makes platform appear broken

trust_credibility_issues.title: Missing AI Accuracy Transparency
trust_credibility_issues.description: Claims 94% AI accuracy but provides no evidence or transparency
trust_credibility_issues.root_cause: Marketing claims not backed by UI explanations
trust_credibility_issues.solution: Add AI transparency features showing how analysis works
implementation_steps: Add confidence scores to flavor suggestions
Update flavor wheel with confidence overlays
validation_steps: Verify AI accuracy claim has supporting evidence
Test confidence score displays
Check data source citations
Review professional appearance
trust_credibility_issues.business_impact: Professionals won't trust AI without transparency

success_criteria: Complete Tasting button saves data successfully
No silent failures in core workflows

phase_2.objective: Build professional confidence and data consistency
success_criteria: Clear error messages for all failure scenarios
phase_2.rollback_plan: Can rollback individual features if needed

steps: Verify same data on Profile page

Add automated tests for critical paths
